title: OpenAI Ne Apple Par Lagaya Trade Secrets Chori Karne Ka Aarop, Court Mein Thoka Countersuit
summary: OpenAI ne Apple ke khilaf California court mein countersuit file karke trade secrets chori karne aur suppliers tak access rokne ka daawa kiya hai.
key_points: OpenAI ne California federal court mein Apple ke khilaf counterclaims file kiye.
ChatGPT maker ne Apple par trade secrets chori karne aur hardware suppliers ko rokne ka aarop lagaya.
Apple ne July mein OpenAI aur former employees par lawsuit file kiya tha, jise OpenAI ne inkaar kiya tha.
OpenAI ka daawa hai ki lagbhag 400 Apple employees ab tak unki company join kar chuke hain.
body: Artificial intelligence company OpenAI ne tech giant Apple ke khilaf California ki ek federal court mein countersuit file kiya hai. Is mamle mein OpenAI ne Apple par unke trade secrets chori karne aur hardware suppliers tak unki access ko rokne ka aarop lagaya hai. Yeh legal action Apple dwara pehle kiye gaye lawsuit ke jawab mein uthaya gaya hai.

Isse pehle July mein Apple ne OpenAI aur apne do purane employees par case kiya tha. Apple ne aarop lagaya tha ki OpenAI ne unke trade secrets ka galat istemal karke consumer hardware mein entry ki hai. OpenAI ne in aaropon ko kharij kar diya tha aur ab court mein Apple par hi palatwar kiya hai.

OpenAI ne court filing mein daawa kiya hai ki Apple ne ek aise purane employee ko wapas re-hire kiya jo chhah mahine tak OpenAI mein kaam kar chuka tha. Us worker ke paas OpenAI ke naye device aur future hardware roadmap ki confidential details thi. OpenAI ka daawa hai ki Apple ne is tarah unki secret jankari haasil ki.

Iske alawa OpenAI ne Apple par apne purane employees ke personal devices aur accounts ko leave karne ke baad bhi monitor karne ka aarop lagaya hai. OpenAI ke mutabiq ab tak lagbhag 400 Apple employees unki company join kar chuke hain aur Apple baki workers ko doosri tech companies mein jaane se rokne ki koshish kar raha hai.
why_it_matters: Dono badi tech companies ke beech AI hardware aur talent ko lekar ladai tez ho rahi hai. Iska asar aane wale waqt mein aane wale naye AI devices aur smartphone technology par pad sakta hai.
